Szukaj oznak ryb i sprawdź dwie głębokoś: Look for signs of fish and check two depths. Start with a small amount of feed rather than spreading it widely.
Sprawdź ruch ryb, tlen i strefę zmiany d: Check fish activity, oxygen and a bottom transition. Place a control rig on a verified spot.
Mały wafter lub bottom; porównaj neutral: Try a small wafter or bottom bait. Compare neutral or sweet against fishmeal on two rigs.
Bottom lub wafter; porównaj fishmeal/kri: Try a bottom bait or wafter. Compare fishmeal or krill with a simple sweet or fruit profile.
Naturalny jako kontrola, jeden jaśniejsz: Use a natural colour as a control and one brighter accent for comparison.
Naturalny na czystej plamie; jeden kontr: Use a natural colour on a clean patch, with one contrasting hookbait if visibility may help.
Lekki wafter albo niski pop-up; sprawdź,: Try a lightly balanced wafter or low pop-up. Check that the lead and hooklink do not sink into silt or weed. Use Ronnie/Spinner only with a safe presentation.
Bottom/wafter na sprawdzonym twardym dni: Try a bottom bait or wafter on verified firm bottom. A simple German or Slip D rig is a starting option; check the hook point.
Wafter na bezpiecznym montażu jako kontr: Use a wafter on a safe rig as a control. Choose the rig after checking the bottom.
Start: kilka kulek lub małe PVA przy zes: Start with a few boilies or a small PVA bag near the rig. Increase only after signs of feeding.
Start: mała punktowa porcja (np. 0,2–0,5: Start with a small concentrated amount, for example 0.2–0.5 kg per spot. Assess the response before adding more.
Czyste oczko lub krawędź zielska z bezpi: A clean opening or weed edge with a safe route to land the fish.
Granica żwiru i mułu, po potwierdzeniu e: The gravel/silt boundary after confirming it with sonar and a lead.
Krawędź twardej plamy lub przejście głęb: The edge of a firm patch or a depth transition.
Krawędź spadu i sąsiednia płytsza półka,: The edge of a drop-off and a nearby shallower shelf, compared on two passes.
Najpierw sprawdź dno, spad i oznaki ryb;: Check the bottom, slope and signs of fish first. Do not commit to a spot without bottom information.
Po 12 godzinach bez oznak ryb zmień jede: After twelve hours without signs of fish, change one variable: location/depth or feed amount. Keep another rig as a control. Reobserve after a weather change.
Termin / temperatura jako wskazówka; rze: Date and air temperature are only clues; actual water temperature is unknown
Punkt startowy z Encyklopedii, testuj re: A starting point from the encyclopedia; test how fish respond
Warunki widoczności i reakcja ryb niepot: Visibility and fish response have not been confirmed
Dno / zielsko z profilu: Bottom and weed from the lake profile
Dno nieznane — wybór warunkowy: Bottom unknown; this choice is conditional
Orientacyjna porcja, zależy od obsady, r: Indicative amount; depends on stock, rules and activity
Encyklopedia: brak brań i zmiana pogody: Encyclopedia: no bites and weather changes
Tylko jawne zapisy; nie wnioskuj o zezwo: Only explicit rules; do not infer permission from missing data
To punkt startowy do sprawdzenia nad wod: These are starting ideas to verify at the water, not a guarantee of bites. The lake profile and forecast do not replace the current rules.
Nie wykryto jednoznacznego zakazu w dost: No explicit prohibition was found in the available fields; check the complete current rules.
Regulamin niezweryfikowany: przed użycie: Rules unverified: check the current rules before using a boat, rig or bait.
Status łódki jest niejednoznaczny — potw: Bait boat status is ambiguous; confirm before use.
Liczba wędek nie jest jednoznaczna — pot: The rod limit is unclear; confirm before setting up.
